blocks.text: Original document: [docs/AUTO_LAYOUT_VBOX_HBOX.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/AUTO_LAYOUT_VBOX_HBOX.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
When generating programmatic animations—especially with LLMs or dynamic mathematical expressions—hardcoding absolute coordinates (`position.set(x, y, z)`) frequently leads to:

items: **Collisions & Overlaps**: Text labels colliding with formulas or graphs because intrinsic glyph bounds vary across fonts and LaTeX equations.
**Frustum Clipping**: Elements placed too far apart drifting outside the camera's field of view.
**Fragile Layouts**: Changing text or formula size requires manually recomputing downstream coordinate offsets.
**Animation Sibling Pop-in**: Adding entities to a shared parent container can cause un-animated siblings to prematurely appear when animating a single child.

blocks.text: Retiam provides **`VBox` (Vertical Box)** and **`HBox` (Horizontal Box)** with a **dual-mode architecture**:

items: **Static Layout Operations (`VBox.arrange(...)` / `HBox.arrange(...)`)**: Pure spatial coordinate positioning without parent-child scene graph coupling. Perfect for sequential animations (`Write(title)`, then `Write(body)`).

**Scene Graph Containers (`new VBox(...)` / `new HBox(...)`)**: Rigid composite entity nodes that group children in the scene graph. Perfect for composite widgets and HUDs that move or fade as a single body.

blocks.text: Both modes use the exact same underlying mathematical layout engine powered by real-time bounding box metrics ([`AABB.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/math/AABB.ts)).

items: **Zero Over-Engineering**: Clean TypeScript extending [`Entity`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Entity.ts), with zero third-party layout dependencies.
**Universal Compatibility**: Works with *any* Retiam entity—primitives, text, LaTeX `Tex`, `MarkupText`, 3D models, math plots, and nested clusters.

children.text: **Static Helper (`arrange`)**: `VBox.arrange({ gap: 0.8, align: 'center', center: [0, 1, 0] }, title, body)`
children: Entities remain top-level independent scene graph nodes (`parent === null`).
Returns array of entities for direct destructuring or camera framing: `camera.frame(VBox.arrange(...))`

children.text: **Container Entity (`new VBox`)**: `const box = new VBox({ gap: 0.8 }, title, body)`
children: Children are attached to `box.children`. Calling `box.relayout()` delegates directly to `VBox.arrange()`.

items: **Cluster & Multi-Column Support**: Pass entity arrays (`Entity[]`) as clusters to compose multi-column layouts without container nodes:
**Camera Auto-Framing Synergy**: Integrates seamlessly with `camera.frame(entities, { padding: 0.2 })`.
Measures bounding boxes for all items (individual entities or cluster union AABBs): $B_i = \text{item}_i.\text{getBoundingBox}(true)$.

children: Otherwise: defaults to the combined bounding box center of all input items.
Applies world shift: $\text{item}.\text{shiftWorld}(\Delta x, \Delta y)$ (all entities in a cluster shift uniformly).
